name: character.gray.name
description: A man in his mid-40s to early 50s, short grey hair, a stern face lined with fatigue. Always in a wheelchair, wearing a dark suit and a light shirt, with a focused expression and an analytical gaze.

en-su-silla-de-ruedas.label: En su silla de ruedas
en-su-silla-de-ruedas.description: Full body, seated upright in a wheelchair, wearing a dark suit and a light shirt. Hands resting calmly on the armrests, facing forward, entire figure visible from the front.

en-su-silla-de-ruedas-traje-oscuro.label: En su silla de ruedas, traje oscuro
en-su-silla-de-ruedas-traje-oscuro.description: Full body, seated upright in a wheelchair, hands resting on the armrests, wearing a dark suit and a light shirt, facing forward.

name: character.adrian.name
description: A man around 40, athletic build, short dark hair and a few days of stubble. Wearing functional field clothing or smart casual, standing upright with an intense gaze.

de-pie-ropa-funcional.label: De pie, ropa funcional
de-pie-ropa-funcional.description: Full body, standing upright facing forward, arms relaxed at sides. Wearing functional field clothing or smart casual outfit, such as a fitted jacket, shirt, and sturdy pants. Neutral stance, entire figure visible from the front.

name: character.wraith.name
description: A tall, powerfully built figure dressed entirely in black, in close-fitting tactical clothing. Wears an opaque mask covering the whole face, dark gloves and boots, no visible features, poised and ready to act.

de-pie-enmascarado.label: De pie, enmascarado
de-pie-enmascarado.description: Full body, standing upright, facing forward, arms slightly bent and ready at the sides, wearing close-fitting black tactical clothing, opaque full-face mask, dark gloves and boots, entire figure visible from head to toe.

name: character.evelyn.name
description: A woman in her early 30s, dark brown hair tied back, sharp features and light eyes. Wearing field gear, a tactical jacket and dark trousers, with a determined expression.

de-pie-con-equipo-tactico.label: De pie, con equipo táctico
de-pie-con-equipo-tactico.description: Standing upright, full body, facing forward, arms relaxed at the sides. Wearing field gear including a tactical jacket and dark trousers. The pose is neutral but ready, suggesting determination.

name: character.iris.name
description: A woman whose face is partly hidden by shadow or pixelation, dark hair worn loose, in a long coat and unobtrusive clothing. Seen on a video call, only part of her face and her determined eyes are visible.

de-pie-rostro-oculto.label: De pie, rostro oculto
de-pie-rostro-oculto.description: Full body, standing facing forward, wearing a long coat and plain, unobtrusive clothing. Arms relaxed at sides. Pose is neutral, with a subtle sense of determination. The figure is seen from the front, entire body visible.

name: character.mirror.name
description: An abstract digital interface, rendered as glowing blue iconography, geometric lines and floating on-screen elements. It has no physical body and no human face.

name: character.june.name
description: A young woman around 30, East Asian features, short black hair, rectangular glasses. Wearing technical or lab clothing, a light jacket over a pale t-shirt.

de-pie-ropa-de-laboratorio.label: De pie, ropa de laboratorio
de-pie-ropa-de-laboratorio.description: Standing upright, facing forward, arms relaxed at sides. Wearing technical or lab clothing, a light jacket over a pale t-shirt. Full body, frontal view.

name: character.elias.name
description: A man around 50, grey hair combed back, a trimmed beard, angular face. Wearing a dark suit and tie, with an authoritative bearing and a calculating gaze.

de-pie-traje-oscuro.label: De pie, traje oscuro
de-pie-traje-oscuro.description: Full body, standing upright with an authoritative posture, arms relaxed at sides, wearing a dark suit and tie, facing forward.

name: character.theo.name
description: A man around 30, fair skin, short messy blond hair, a square jaw. Wearing a dark tactical uniform over a black t-shirt, with a serious expression.

de-pie-uniforme-tactico.label: De pie, uniforme táctico
de-pie-uniforme-tactico.description: Full body, standing upright facing forward, arms relaxed at sides, wearing a dark tactical uniform over a black t-shirt, boots visible, neutral stance.

name: character.marcus.name
description: A man around 35, dark skin, a strong build, very short hair and a neatly trimmed beard. Wearing tactical clothing and a bulletproof vest, standing firmly.

de-pie-ropa-tactica.label: De pie, ropa táctica
de-pie-ropa-tactica.description: Full body, standing firmly facing forward, arms relaxed at sides, wearing tactical clothing and a bulletproof vest.

name: character.lena.name
description: A woman in her late 20s, fair skin, straight blonde hair to the shoulders, delicate features and light eyes. Wearing simple clothes, a pale sweater and a light jacket.

de-pie-ropa-sencilla.label: De pie, ropa sencilla
de-pie-ropa-sencilla.description: Standing upright, facing forward, arms relaxed at the sides. Wearing a pale sweater and a light jacket, simple full-length clothing. Full body, neutral pose.

name: character.daniel.name
description: A man in his early 30s, fair skin, short brown hair, light stubble. Wearing an office shirt and trousers, with an ID badge hanging around his neck.

de-pie-con-credencial.label: De pie, con credencial
de-pie-con-credencial.description: Standing upright, facing forward, arms relaxed at his sides. Wearing an office shirt and trousers, with an ID badge hanging around his neck. Full body, front view.
